summary.text: Jim Spillane is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Rockingham 2 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 primary.

paragraphs.text: James Spillane assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 3, 2014, according to Ballotpedia.
